caseName: Trustees of Pillsbury Academy v. Minnesota
caseNameFull: Trustees of Pillsbury Academy v. Minnesota
attorneys: Messrs. Herbert T. Park and G. A. Youngquist, for appellants. 'Messrs. Chester S. Wilson, ■ Alfred W. Bowen, and Frank J. Williams for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgments of the Supreme Court of Minnesota are affirmed. Violet Trapping Co. v. Grace, 297 U. S. 119, 120; Ingraham v. Hanson, 297 U. S. 378, 381; Schenebeck v. McCrary, 298 U. S. 36, 37. Mr. Justice Black took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.
